purpose: Status bar for a vertical Apodex-style closed-loop research agent focused on US equity momentum factor risk (not a general Heavy-Duty Solver).

target.shape: Apodex 1.1 managed loop: gaps → Task Pipeline → executable environment + coordination → traces → eval → next round
target.domain: US equity momentum factor risk (Daniel-Moskowitz crash, crowding, unwind). Overlay profiles are inputs to that question, not separate products.
target.not_in_scope: General-purpose Heavy-Duty Solver, SFT/RL on DeepSeek weights, AgentBus, unbounded follow-up

implemented_on_main: DeliveryContract attached to engine_query (pass only if pipeline_run=True)
runtime profile overlay from OPEN gaps
resolve_consumed_gaps CLOSED or back to OPEN
left: V_D that re-derives risk_state / fingerprint / as_of (not subprocess-wrote-JSON)
unvendor fixtures/engine src + 38MB parquet; keep upstream pin + small gold JSON
live replan / staged return / branch stop (not retry engine_query)
prompt overlay that does not leak into the verifier
eval with more than one frozen date whose failures can reopen

reference.paper: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
reference.definition: Self-evolution is the managed loop: observed gaps → Task Pipeline → Environment Scaling + Agentic Coordination Scaling → SFT/agentic RL → evaluation/failure attribution. It is not the model rewriting its own weights. This repo implements the system-level analogue only (frozen DeepSeek, no weight training).

overall.summary: PR #9+#10 landed: live run_mvp, a shallow DeliveryContract, one kind=replan, runtime overlay, and a one-date --eval writeback. Official score 38 → 48, matching the pre-merge forecast. The blockers are now on main: V_D is subprocess-wrote-JSON, replan retries engine_query, overlay leaks into the verifier, and fixtures/engine vendors 49MB of monitor src+parquet.

dimensions.name: Capability-gap mining
dimensions.apodex: Classify real-task failures, benchmark errors, and user/expert feedback into capability deficiencies.
present: BLOCKED tasks and Task.error.
EvidenceVerdict rejected/unchecked is claim-level failure labeling.
verification.json compiles GapKind rows with trace_ids.
reports/gap_ledger.jsonl with MomentumCapability and OPEN/CONSUMED/CLOSED.
--eval writes eval:{case_id} back into the ledger.
missing: Classification is keyword regex, not clustered real-task failures.
SOURCE_QUALITY rows are never planted.
append_gaps dedupes by evidence_id forever, so a later eval failure cannot reopen.

dimensions.name: Task Pipeline
dimensions.apodex: Convert classified gaps into the next task distribution with family-specific verification before training signal.
present: followup_specs() emits at most 2 repair tasks from rejected/unchecked evidence.
seed_open_gaps() plants at most 2 kind=gap tasks (crowding→flow, unwind/engine→momentum).
maybe_replan() plants one kind=replan momentum_analyst.
missing: Gap and replan tasks repair prior claims or retry engine_query; they are not a factory of new momentum research worlds.
SOURCE_QUALITY never becomes a task.

dimensions.name: Environment Scaling
dimensions.apodex: File / search / code worlds with state, tools, transitions, budgets, delivery contract D, and verifier V_D.
present: engine_query prefers live run_mvp via scripts/run_monitor.py subprocess.
DeliveryContract: only pipeline_run=True can verdict=pass; snapshots and local_dm cannot.
Poisoned structured_snapshot.json does not affect pass (tested).
Labeled mock fallback when no snapshot and no pipeline.
missing: pipeline_pass() does not re-derive risk_state / fingerprint / as_of; it accepts whatever run_mvp wrote.
end is None skips the pipeline entirely and falls through to snapshot / local_dm / mock.
fixtures/engine vendors monitor src + 49.9MB parquet instead of an upstream pin + gold JSON.
local_dm live-downloads 2y SPY via yfinance (not PIT).
warm_pipeline is a sync 90s × two frozen dates on the event loop.

dimensions.name: Agentic Coordination Scaling
dimensions.apodex: Trained policy for decompose, delegate, staged return, shared-state revision, replan, and stop obsolete branches. Runtime: live task board, async human intervention, asymmetric verification, adaptive team effort.
present: Coordinator path: decompose → gap seed → warm → dispatch → replan → verify → follow_up → verify → synthesize.
Disk TaskBoard; sub-agent failure does not abort the run.
At most one kind=replan after the first wave (BLOCKED / mock / stale / V_D fail / pipeline_run is not True).
missing: decompose.md still requires self-contained tasks.
kind=replan retries engine_query(end=2026-05-29); it does not edit a shared plan or stop branches.
should_replan / maybe_replan do not count as live_replan.
pipeline_run is not True fires on the default engine_query(ticker) path (no end), so the first wave almost always replans.
No async human intervention.

dimensions.name: Asymmetric / independent verification
dimensions.apodex: Narrow verifier attacks a claim + evidence + delivery constraint; does not re-solve the whole problem.
present: Independent Verifier judges existing evidence_ids only.
static_audit fail-closed; more_conservative merge with LLM re-check.
Verifier compiles the session ledger (finalize_ledger).
missing: load_profile unconditionally appends profile_hints.md; Verifier uses load_profile('verifier'). Overlay leaks into the checker. Regression vs #7 (40 → 38).
No statement-level counterexample attack on crowding/unwind claims.

dimensions.name: Trajectory learning (SFT / agentic RL or system analogue)
dimensions.apodex: Unified SFT then agentic RL (PIVOT-RL) over executable and coordination trajectories. Self-evolution reallocates training effort; it does not let the model edit itself.
present: Frozen DeepSeek API client. Models are not trained here.
traces.jsonl + ToolTrace + replay_trace for engine_query / web_search.
refresh_profile_hints writes reports/profile_hints.md from OPEN/CONSUMED gaps; CLOSED rows drop.
missing: Overlay is [A-Z]{1,5} ticker extraction, not a trajectory policy.
Overlay leaks into the verifier (see asymmetric_verification).

dimensions.name: Evaluation and failure attribution
dimensions.apodex: ReAct vs Agent Team eval; capability analysis feeds the next Task Pipeline.
present: Unit tests including audit, verifier, followup, engine adapter, ledger, gap-seed/resolve, replan, overlay, and eval.
--eval runs one frozen case (2026-05-29 / normal) with no DeepSeek and writes failures back.
missing: Not a working-capability benchmark (probe working_capability_bench still dark).
Only one frozen date, and it is the normal state.
Failures are GapKind.ENGINE_MOCK and cannot reopen after the first writeback.

last_probe.note: 19/22 on 7f3c893. New vs #7: delivery_verifier, prompt_evolution. Still missing: new_environment_factory, live_replan, working_capability_bench. live_replan correctly ignores should_replan / maybe_replan.

nearest_moves: Unvendor fixtures/engine src + parquet. Keep subprocess + MOMENTUM_ENGINE_DIR / sibling pin plus a small JSON gold.
Attach a V_D that re-derives risk_state / fingerprint / as_of; crowding/unwind assertions stay on the verifier.
engine_query without end must resolve an as-of or fail-closed. Replan only on BLOCKED or true mock / verdict=fail.
Overlay research profiles only; Verifier must not load profile_hints.md.
Frozen eval with at least two as-of dates (including a non-normal state) whose failures can reopen.
Move warm_pipeline off the event loop and cache under the session, not the engine root.
